entries.competence: 1.0 LISTEN TO , ANALYZE TEXT AND RELATE THEM TO REALLY SITUATIONS
entries.objective: A learner should be able to listen ,understand and respond to text from different sources
entries.main_topic: 1.0 listening for information from different sources
entries.teaching_act: Introduce new vocabulary using texts, songs or games Learners are to be guided on listening to a text especially a text based on challenges facing Youths like HIV/AIDS, STDs forms of Child labour and Effects of drug abuse in the society. Arrange the learners in groups to react on text based on challenges facing Youths in the society. Lead the learners to acquire the general idea from the text.
entries.learning_act: Learners to listen and note new vocabularies. The given task should be done in groups under the supervision of a teacher. The derived vocabulary has to be applied in regard to the text The general theme of the text is to be outlined.
entries.materials: Text from various contents like HIV/AIDS, Child labour Child Abuse newspapers, journals etc
entries.assessment: Are the learners able to identify new vocabularies from the text?

entries.objective: Learners should be able to express themselves orally and writing using appropriate language in various settings and situations.
entries.main_topic: 2.0 Using Language Content and style in Speaking
entries.teaching_act: Interviews and dialogues on current events are to be demonstrated Debates are to organized following appropriate procedures Topics are to be prepared and meaning of impromptu speech should be given and the way it is conducted. Divide learners into group and lead them to select group leaders.
entries.learning_act: Learners are to in pairs to practice; interviews/ dialogues under the guidance of the teacher. The chairperson, the secretary and time keeper are to be selected to lead the debate. Learners are to practice speaking while others listen. Issues discussed in debates should be written in a logical way.
entries.materials: Different samples of interviews and speeches
entries.assessment: Are the learners able to conduct interviews and speak appropriately?

entries.objective: Learners be able to read and understand slightly complex texts.
entries.teaching_act: Tests on a variety of issues like causes of environmental degradation , a forestation, global warming and women harassment are to be presented. From the texts, new vocabulary should be introduced. Learners are to be guided in writing summary on the board Independent level of reading of each learner using proficiency texts are to be identified
entries.learning_act: Learners are to read books on their own under the guidance of the teacher Learners should read texts and discuss the correct answers in groups.
entries.materials: Varieties of texts in various contexts.
entries.assessment: Are the learners able to write summary on the text selected?

entries.main_topic: 4.1 Identifying Form and Content 4.2 I denitrifying the main features of different genres 4.3 Context and style
entries.period: Learners to be brainstormed on the covers and back pages of various literal texts to analyze; Title, setting Plot. Genres of Literature such as Novels , short Stories, Plays and Poetry are to be described Learners are to be assigned roles in finding outcome common Literary terms and their descriptions related to various genres analyzing various styles used and Diction
entries.teaching_act: React to brainstorms from the teacher. Different questions on genres of literature are to be answered. Students are to go to Library and identify various genres such as Novels , short Stories, Plays and Poetry
entries.references: Are the learners able to categorize various literal texts correctly?

entries.competence: Use appropriate Language context and style in expression.
entries.objective: Use appropriate Language context and style.
entries.main_topic: 5.0 Writing using appropriate language context and s style.
entries.teaching_act: Composition models are to be used to brainstorm on how to organize ideas in an essay format. Provide various topics to Learners to select and discuss them in groups hence write them individually. Learners are to be guided to correct spellings and other technical errors (proof reading) from their written texts. Learners are to be guided on listing the main points which support the topic and those which oppose as written by the learners.
entries.learning_act: Learners to react on the brain storm. Learners to select various topics to discuss. Learners to identify errors and correct them. Learners list the main points which support the topic and those which oppose.
entries.materials: Samples of ; essays, creative writings, expository essays, descriptive essays and argumentative essays
entries.references: Oxford Secondary English Form Three , Newspapers, Journals , Magazines
entries.assessment: Are the learners able to use appropriate language in writing main points in a composition?

entries.competence: Use appropriate Language context and style in expression.
entries.teaching_act: Learners are to brainstorm on the kind of written works they would write on eg creative writing Letter writing, writing official business transactions letters.
entries.learning_act: Learners to react on the brainstorm. Learners to practice creative writing like; Letter writing, writing official business transactions letters
entries.assessment: Are the learners able to practice creative writing?

entries.competence: Use English language to to construct ideas and provide subject matter information in written form
entries.objective: Learners should be able to write letters to editor.
entries.teaching_act: The teacher to guide the learners to brainstorm why people write letters, types of letters and issues that one can write about in letters to the editors A teacher to write on the board ideas on writing letters to the editor. The teacher to introduce the format of letters to the editors. After drafting, learners to revise/edit their letters with the help of the teacher The teacher to display the letters for learners to reads in their own time
entries.learning_act: Learners to read sample letters. Learners to choose a topic on which to write a letter to the editor.

entries.teaching_act: Using sample letters, the teacher to introduce the format and purpose of business transaction letters. The teacher to go round the class assisting the learners on how to write a business transaction letter.
entries.learning_act: Learners to ; choose a topic to write on Learners to draft their Letters Edit their own written letters
entries.assessment: Is the learner able to write business transaction letters?
